task.title: Find a person
task.shortdesc: Search your tree by a name, a place or an event, then open the person you want.

context.p: The search box is on . It searches the tree that is open, and it also looks at the other names a person has. On other screens, the button with a magnifying glass at the top opens the search.

step.cmd: Type a name, a place or an event in the search box.

stepresult.p: The results come in two columns. The people are on the left. The events are on the right. A small badge on each person, such as Sources: 10, says how many sources back that person up. When the iPad is upright, the results are in one column, with buttons above them to show everything, only the people or only the events.

step.cmd: Choose the card of the person you want.

stepresult.p: The page of that person opens. Their name shows in the chip that starts with .

result.p: Now , and all show that person.
To see everyone without a search, choose on . The list gives each person's name, years, sources and events.

postreq.p: To narrow the results, choose the button with the sliders next to . A list named opens. Tick , , or to add a filter. Tick to also find names that sound alike. Choose to start again.
